Package CPDFGeneration

Class CEmailConverter

java.lang.Object
CPDFGeneration.CEmailConverter
public final class CEmailConverter extends Object
Synchronous EML/MSG conversion through email API V1. Load the SDK native library before use; PDF output also requires a valid initialized license. HTML parsing and export do not require a license. Always close the returned result, even on failure. A nonnegative status means success, including success with warnings.

InputStream overloads read the declared number of bytes from the current position; they use bounded callback reads and require the length rather than available(). Caller streams are never closed or flushed. I/O and cancellation exceptions become native failure statuses with CEmailResult.GetLastCallbackException() retaining the original Java exception. Result data survives PDF/write/license failures. Do not modify input arrays until the synchronous call returns.

Required inputs, outputs and formats must not be null. Invalid native arguments normally produce a result with an error status. Java-side validation throws IllegalArgumentException for paths containing NUL or negative byte budgets, and IllegalStateException for callback reentry or released converter properties. Java/JNI allocation failures may throw OutOfMemoryError.

Null options select CEmailOptions defaults. Null PDF properties select A4 with repeating margins of 32 CSS pixels at the top/bottom and 40 at the sides. Supplied properties preserve their configured margins, including zero, and are not modified. Keep properties and their font provider valid and unchanged during conversion. PDF output contains the body and optional attachment list, but does not embed attachments or convert them to additional pages.

Independent email results may be parsed or exported concurrently; email PDF rendering is serialized by the native API. Do not render concurrently through the legacy HTML API or change global license/font state during a PDF conversion. Callbacks must not reenter the SDK.

Since:
1.3.0

    • ConvertToHtml

      public static CEmailResult ConvertToHtml(InputStream input, long length, CEmailFormat format, CEmailOptions options)
      Read a declared number of email bytes sequentially and generate HTML. Short reads are retried; premature end of stream yields CEmailStatus.EMAIL_ERROR_READ with an EOFException retained in the result. The input is not closed.
      Parameters:
      input - email stream positioned at the start of the message
      length - nonnegative byte count to read from the current position; an invalid or unsupported length yields an invalid-parameter status
      format - required input format, including automatic detection
      options - options copied at entry, or null for defaults
      Returns:
      owned conversion result; inspect its status and close it even on failure
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an option byte budget is negative
      IllegalStateException - if called reentrantly from an email callback

    • ConvertToPdf

      public static CEmailResult ConvertToPdf(String input, String output, CEmailFormat format, CEmailOptions options, CConverterProperties properties)
      Parse an email file and render a new PDF with a valid initialized license. Output is created exclusively: existing files are preserved, and a partial file created by this operation is removed on failure. Generated HTML and attachments remain available in the result if PDF generation fails.
      Parameters:
      input - path of the EML or MSG file
      output - path of the new PDF
      format - required input format, including automatic detection
      options - options copied at entry, or null for defaults
      properties - borrowed PDF properties, or null for default email page properties; supplied margins, including zero, are preserved
      Returns:
      owned conversion result; inspect its status and close it even on failure
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a path contains NUL or a byte budget is negative
      IllegalStateException - if properties have been released or this method is called reentrantly from an email callback

    • ConvertToPdf

      public static CEmailResult ConvertToPdf(InputStream input, long length, OutputStream output, CEmailFormat format, CEmailOptions options, CConverterProperties properties)
      Read a declared number of email bytes and render a PDF with a valid license. Reading starts at the stream's current position; short reads are retried and premature EOF produces a read error. Neither stream is closed or flushed. Stream exceptions are retained by CEmailResult.GetLastCallbackException(). Discard partial output on failure or cancellation.
      Parameters:
      input - email stream positioned at the start of the message
      length - nonnegative byte count to read; invalid or unsupported lengths yield an invalid-parameter status
      output - caller-owned PDF output stream
      format - required input format, including automatic detection
      options - options copied at entry, or null for defaults
      properties - borrowed PDF properties, or null for default email page properties
      Returns:
      owned conversion result; inspect its status and close it even on failure
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an option byte budget is negative
      IllegalStateException - if properties have been released or this method is called reentrantly from an email callback
